atm.summary: How to pay at a CaixaBank ATM without a Spanish card

steps.title: Go to a CaixaBank ATM
steps.detail: You do not need a CaixaBank account or any Spanish card. Take your printed Modelo 790 and the exact amount in cash.

steps.title: Select ‘Pagar impuestos y tasas’
steps.detail: Choose it on the start screen, without inserting a card.

steps.title: Scan the 13-digit barcode
steps.detail: Hold the barcode on your printed form to the ATM’s reader. The amount appears on screen: check it says {fee}.

steps.title: Staple the voucher to page 3
steps.detail: Collect the printed voucher: it is your proof of payment. Staple it to page 3 of the form and bring both to your appointment.

atm.fallback: If the ATM will not read the barcode, pay at the counter inside any CaixaBank, BBVA or Santander branch during opening hours. Some branches take tax payments only in the morning.

sheet.title: Your appointment day
checklistTie: Passport (original), plus a photocopy of the photo page and of your visa
One recent colour photo, 32 × 26 mm, white background (bring a spare)
Modelo 790 Código 012, paid: the stamped copy or the ATM voucher stapled to it
Your printed appointment confirmation (justificante de cita)
checklistEu: Passport or national ID card (original), plus a photocopy
Modelo 790 Código 012, paid: the stamped copy or the ATM voucher stapled to it
Your printed appointment confirmation (justificante de cita)
Your Ready File documents: enrolment certificate, health insurance and declaration of means
afterTie: You will be given a receipt (resguardo). Keep it: you need it to collect your card.
Your card is collected later, in person. We will tell you when and where.
afterEu: The certificate is usually handed over at the appointment. Check every detail on it before you leave.
Keep it with your passport: it proves your registration.

meaning.greetTie: Good morning, I have an appointment for fingerprints.
meaning.greetEu: Good morning, I have an appointment for the EU registration certificate.
meaning.handOver: Here is my passport and the fee receipt.
meaning.collectCard: When can I collect the card?
meaning.certificateToday: Will I get the certificate today?
meaning.repeat: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly, please?
